steps.prompt: Read $FLEET_INPUT_DIR/example/snapshot.json. It contains the experiment, pinned configuration, variants, tune/held-out scores, spend and budgets. Propose the next variants to improve the primary tune score, following generator params; never tune on held-out data or change budgets. If keep_best is true, start from the current best variant and explain the change. Write output/strategy.json and output/output.json with identical JSON: {"action":"next" or "stop","variants":[{"label":"description","overrides":{...}}],"reason":"evidence and reason"}. Use stop when no justified change remains. Retain uncertainty, do not invent scores.
